# First Marketing Hire

`first-marketing-hire` · v1.0.0 · Design · Growth, Retention & RevOps
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/first-marketing-hire/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Should we hire this candidate as our first marketer, turn them down, or gather more evidence first?

**Inputs:** The stage, the channel that already brings in most customers, what the hire must own in months 1 to 6, competencies with weights and must-haves, and each interviewer's 1-4 ratings with an evidence note per competency

**Output:** A role scorecard, a paid take-home brief with rubric, interview questions by stage tied to competencies, a first-90-days plan, and per candidate a weighted score, must-haves below bar, ratings without evidence, interviewer disagreements and a hire, no-hire or more-evidence call

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill first-marketing-hire`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/first-marketing-hire/resources/hire-scorecard.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/first-marketing-hire/resources/hire-scorecard.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code.

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- Weights, must-haves, bars and the 3.0 hire line are your inputs or AAJ's defaults, not benchmarks. A badly written role profile produces a confident wrong call.
- It scores only ratings with an evidence note but cannot judge whether a note is true or relevant; notes under four words are flagged as thin, nothing more.
- It holds no salary or cost data. Any pay figure is the user's own, from public wage data for the location; the engine does not compare cost.
- It does not check whether the company is ready to hire (retention in a segment, a working channel, founder time). A high score does not mean a hire will work.

**Review before acting:** The founder confirms the month 1 to 6 outcomes and must-haves before interviews, and puts split interviewers in one room with their notes before acting on the call. Counsel checks interview, pay-disclosure and reference rules.

Method: [skills.aajconsult.com/skills/first-marketing-hire](https://skills.aajconsult.com/skills/first-marketing-hire)
